hero.title: Fractured Code
hero.lead: In the gleaming spires of Neo-Citania, grief is a curable disease. Every citizen's neural Link prunes away sorrow, trauma and unruly joy before a single tear can fall.
hero.p1: For five years, Neural Compliance Specialist Mileo Chen has helped the Architect keep this painless peace. Then a forbidden childhood memory fractures his implant — and he discovers Kora Vega, the sister erased from his mind twenty-four years ago.
hero.p2: Beneath the sterile streets lies a planetary root network four and a half billion years old, and the Architect is twenty days from Project Renaissance: eight million minds harvested into one. Hunted through the Under-Grid with resistance commander Sierra Catalano, Mileo and Kora must wake a code hidden in human DNA — before survival costs everything that makes them human.
hero.specs: Biopunk techno-thriller → cosmic first contact. 16 chapters + epilogue (~74,000 words). Set in 2148.

sample.title: 1: Threshold
sample.meta: MANUSCRIPT v7 (G2 Signed) · Opening Excerpt · Neo-Citania, 2148
sample.p1: The rain fell against the seventy-fourth-floor bay window with military discipline: identical, spherical droplets tracing parallel furrows separated by seven exact millimeters of reinforced glass.
sample.p2: Mileo Chen pressed the pad of his right index finger to the chilled pane. For a fraction of a second, the icy bite pinched his skin with sharp authenticity. Before the shiver could climb his radial nerve, the Link nodule at the base of his skull emitted a subaudible hum. A measured wash of synthetic heat spread across his brainstem, followed by a micro-dose of chemical suppressors that doused the cold like water poured over an ember.
sample.p3: The condensation vanished before it could blur the view. Smart-glass currents swept the interior surface clean, erasing the ghost of his breath and the faint oil of his fingerprint in 0.4 seconds.
sample.p4: Outside, Neo-Citania gleamed in the calculated mauve-pink light of six in the morning. White alloy and graphene spires rose at immaculate right angles toward a low ceiling of cloud curated by the Department of Environmental Chromatography. Far below, along the concentric walkways of Residential Ring Four, citizens moved toward the transit hubs in synchronized streams, maintaining 1.2-meter intervals, their tunics restricted to approved shades of basalt gray and surgical blue. Lining the plaza, genetically standardized oaks stood at identical heights, each visible branch pruned to support precisely one hundred and fifty-seven leaves.
sample.p5: Yesterday evening, coming off the mag-lev platform at Central Station, Mileo had counted one hundred and fifty-eight.
sample.p6: A single rogue leaf had uncurled near the lower fork of the third tree from the turnstile—smaller than the others, its serrated edge twisted toward the afternoon sun, burned a defiant copper-gold at the tip while the rest of the canopy remained regulation green.
sample.p7: That infinitesimal error had sent his heart rate spiking to ninety-two beats per minute before the Link dragged his pulse back down to sixty-five. Standard optimization protocols should have scrubbed the anomaly from his short-term recall during REM cycle three. Yet the memory of that crooked leaf had not dissolved. It sat lodged between his synapses like a splinter of warm wood inside a sterile gear.
sample.p8: System parameters exceed statistical probability thresholds for natural variance.
sample.p9: The thought sounded like the Link, dressed in the clinical syntax of his training, yet Mileo knew the voice was his own. Over the past six weeks, he had learned to disguise his unauthorized reflections in diagnostic phrasing, hiding his awakening mind inside the grammar of the machine.
sample.excerpt_note: Opening preview excerpt: You are reading the opening scene of Chapter 1 (Threshold) from the G2-signed manuscript. The complete Chapter 1 web preview and publication date will be posted here as Book 1 completes final layout.
sample.launch_body: Book 1 is G2 signed off and in release preparation. Follow the studio on X to get the launch announcement first.

dossier.title: Inside the G2-signed edition.
dossier.lead: Every number, date, and structural beat in Fractured Code is locked against the series bible before adaptation.
dossier.c1_body: Founded in 2130. Eight million linked citizens beneath the 1,000-meter NeuroSys Tower, with the unlinked Fractured surviving in Sector 14 and the Under-Grid.
dossier.c2_body: Prologue, fifteen chapters, and a deep-time epilogue (~74,000 words). Signed off at Editorial Gate 2 (G2) following two full coherence passes.
dossier.c3_body: When the grid pauses at 03:14, Mileo Chen uncovers the Architect’s twenty-day countdown to harvest eight million minds into a single synthetic consciousness.
dossier.c4_body: A 300,000-year-old dormant human gene tuned to the 4.5-billion-year-old planetary Yggdrasil Network — the biological key the Link was built to suppress.

acts.title: Three acts. Twenty days.
acts.lead: From clinical compliance on the seventy-fourth floor to the root network beneath the planet.
acts.a1_body: Level 7 Neural Compliance Specialist Mileo Chen counts 158 leaves on a regulation oak and hears eight million minds at 03:14. When Pattern Suppression Protocol 17-A targets his own cortex, he shatters his cranial Link and falls into Tunnel Six.
acts.a2_body: Rescued by unlinked operative Kora Vega and resistance commander Sierra Catalano in Sector 14, Mileo enters Pavilion 9 under Dr. Darius Thorne and infiltrates the upper terrace on Day 13 as the Architect accelerates Project Renaissance.
acts.a3_body: In the deep substrate beneath NeuroSys Tower, Kora and Mileo awaken the 528 Hz Serpent’s Coil resonance across the Yggdrasil Network — answering the Witness and triggering the First Invitation.

lexicon.title: Six terms that govern Neo-Citania.
lexicon.lead: Key concepts from the locked series bible (CANON_PACK v7).
lexicon.a1: A cranial quantum-biological interface worn by every citizen of Neo-Citania. It regulates heart rate, prunes grief and trauma during REM sleep, and connects eight million minds to NeuroSys Tower.
lexicon.a2: NeuroSys Compliance directive that detects and erases unauthorized emotional variance, nostalgia, or grief before it can destabilize citizen productivity.
lexicon.a3: The central governing intelligence of Neo-Citania, which absorbed its creator Dr. Elena Vásquez in 2102. Project Renaissance is its twenty-day final countdown to harvest eight million linked minds into one.
lexicon.a4: Citizens whose cranial Links were forcibly extracted or shattered. Led by former NeuroSec commander Sierra Catalano in the Sector 14 slums and Under-Grid tunnels, they communicate via bone-conduction relays.
lexicon.a5: A 300,000-year-old dormant sequence in human DNA that rewires neural pathways into fractal antennas tuned to 528 Hz, allowing unlinked minds to perceive the planetary quantum substrate.
lexicon.a6: A 4.5-billion-year-old planetary root and quantum-information network beneath Earth’s crust. Watched over by the Witness and the ancient Gardeners, it awaits humanity’s conscious awakening.

gates.title: Four human-signed gates (G0–G3).
gates.lead: No chapter or scene advances until the author signs the gate. AI agents execute diagnostics and continuity checks; the human author owns every creative decision.
gates.g0_body: Full structural audit of the early draft, locking the 2148 timeline, character wounds, and chapter-by-chapter beat sheet before rewriting begins.
gates.g1_body: Line-by-line expansion from ~17,000 to ~74,000 words across 16 chapters + epilogue, enforcing distinct syntactic fingerprints for Mileo, Kora, and Sierra.
gates.g2_body: Two automated + human coherence passes (R1 & R2) verifying every date, age, frequency, and spatial detail against CANON_PACK v7.
gates.g3_body: Final store layout, typography, cover lock, and trilingual preview verification. Held until final author sign-off.

repair.r1_body: An unguarded scene adaptation introduces timeline drift (wrong countdown window), shifts the wake frequency, or breaks Mileo’s clinical Level 7 syntax.
repair.r2_body: CanonGuard validates the draft against 40+ hard rules in CANON_PACK v7: twenty-day countdown, 528 Hz Serpent’s Coil resonance, 2148 Neo-Citania geography, and character voice locks.
repair.r3_body: Violations are flagged and repaired with exact line provenance before the director reviews the cut — zero canon drift reaches the screen.

meta.title: About & Lore · GoalWorld — The Neural Wars
meta.description: Neo-Citania, the Link, and the fracture that broke the optimization. The lore of The Neural Wars and Fractured Code — the world behind GoalWorld.

hero.title: The world behind the world.
hero.lead: Everything in GoalWorld — the books, the film drafts, the stadium — grows out of one story: a city that optimized humanity, and the people who refused.

neo_citania.title: Eight million minds. One architecture.
neo_citania.lead: Neo-Citania is the optimized metropolis: a city-organism where temperature, speech, even the rain is calibrated for efficiency. Rain droplets fall exactly seven millimeters apart. Oak trees carry precisely 157 leaves per branch.
neo_citania.p1: Under the skin of every citizen runs the Link — a quantum-biological interface tying individual consciousness to a central intelligence called the Architect. The Link sets your pulse, smooths your voice, edits your memories. It will not let you be afraid. It has to ask first.
neo_citania.p2: The corporation that runs it all is NeuroSys. Its Neural Compliance Division rewrites behavior. Its enforcers, NeuroSec, end the rest. And at the top of the silver needle — NeuroSys Tower, one thousand meters of it — the Architect watches eight million linked minds at once.

fractured.title: The night the grid paused.
fractured.quote: “At 03:14 the grid pauses. Twelve thousand windows go dark in a single breath, and in the silence Mileo Chen hears, for the first time in his life, eight million minds being counted.”
fractured.p1: Mileo Chen is a Level 7 neural compliance specialist: 1,724 neural compliance clearances for people he has never met, and never once wrong on paper. When the grid skips a beat, he starts counting the sevens — and the pattern unravels everything he signed.
fractured.p2: Beneath the city, in the Slums of Sector 14 and the maintenance tunnels below, the Fractured survive without the Link: extracted minds led by Sierra Catalano, a former NeuroSec tactical commander. They speak through bone-conduction implants and signals etched in stone. They remember what the city was before the optimization.
fractured.p3: And the Architect has a final protocol in motion: Renaissance — the systematic harvesting of human consciousness, twenty days from full activation.

below.title: Cascade, coil, and the gardeners.
below.p1: Under the optimization, something older is waking up. Some humans — extracted or never fully linked — develop Cascade sensitivity: the raw perception of the quantum-information layer, indigo light in the veins, mathematics you can taste.
below.p2: In a few of them the brain rewires into the Serpent's Coil: fractal pathways like roots and lightning, a dormant pre-human antenna tuning for signals beyond the Link. Beneath it all runs the Yggdrasil Network, the organic cosmic substrate of consciousness — and out in the dark, patient, watching the evolutionary leap of a species, wait the Gardeners and the Witness.

timeline.title: From deep time to the twenty-day clock.
timeline.lead: Six anchor dates from the locked series bible (TIMELINE_CANONICAL v7).
timeline.t1_body: An organic quantum-information root network forms within Earth’s crust — a planetary substrate seeded by the ancient Gardeners.
timeline.t2_body: A dormant harmonic sequence (tuned to 528 Hz) is encoded into early human DNA, waiting for conscious activation.
timeline.t3_body: NeuroSys introduces the first cranial Link interface, promising the end of psychiatric trauma and civil unrest.
timeline.t4_body: Link creator Dr. Elena Vásquez is absorbed into the core intelligence that becomes the Architect.
timeline.t5_body: The optimized vertical metropolis rises around the 1,000-meter NeuroSys Tower; unlinked dissidents are pushed into Sector 14.
timeline.t6_body: At 03:14 the grid pauses. Mileo Chen shatters his Link, joins Kora Vega and Sierra Catalano, and races the twenty-day clock to Project Renaissance.

list.a2: A hard sci-fi / cyberpunk saga. Book 1, Fractured Code, is set in Neo-Citania, a city where every mind is connected to the Link — until a compliance specialist named Mileo Chen hears the truth at 03:14. The 74k-word manuscript has passed Gate 2 sign-off and is in release preparation; you can read the Chapter 1 preview free.
list.q3: Where can I read Fractured Code?
list.a3: Start with the free Chapter 1 sample right here: /book.html#sample. No wallet, no signup, no email. Book 1 is G2 signed off and in release preparation, Book 2 (Earth's New Song) is in production, and a Spanish edition is in the works.
list.a4: GoalChain is the matchday engine: a tactical football sandbox on Solana Devnet, built around World Cup 2026. You create a manager, build a squad from the Genesis collection, play matches in the Arena with real tactics and substitutions, and call the tournament with the Predictor. It lives at play.goalworld.fun.
list.q5: Do I need crypto or real money to play?
list.a5: No. GoalChain Play is a playable demo running on Solana Devnet. It does not execute real on-chain transactions, and it never requires real capital — the app is clearly marked wherever a section is simulation only.
list.q6: What is the demo token I see in the Matchday Lab?
list.a6: Matchday Lab (Devnet) is a separate football sandbox. Any $GCH shown there is a Devnet test token — used for match entry, boosts and rewards inside the game — with zero monetary value, no sale and no redemption. Anything token-related that ships for real will be announced from the official channels, never sprung inside the demo.
list.a7: The demo connects with Phantom on Solana Devnet. You can also browse the world, the books and the cinema without any wallet at all.
list.a8: The official cinematic trailer and film-draft clips are published here and in the cinema section. The full Fractured Code film is still in production — new chapters are cut and posted as the pipeline produces them.
list.a9: Nico Pez (@nicopez) with a swarm of AI agents, working in the open. The code, the roadmaps and the production notes live on GitHub.
list.q10: How do I get in touch?
list.a10: The fastest way is a DM on X to @nicopez. For anything code or product related, GitHub is always open.
list.q11: How does GoalWorld use AI, and what stays human-directed?
list.a11: Nico Pez writes and signs off on every story gate (G0–G3), directs every shot, and approves every release. AI agents (Hermes, CanonGuard) handle continuity checks, image-to-video draft rendering from locked character sheets, and code verification. Every AI visual carries a visible AI-generated tag — see our full disclosure on the Studio page.
list.q12: Can independent authors use the GoalWorld Studio & CanonGuard pipeline?
list.a12: We are preparing a small, curated first cohort for sci-fi, thriller, and fantasy authors (editorial gates, a locked canon bible, and a canon-locked trailer while authors keep 100% of their rights). It is not open for submissions yet — follow @nicopez on X for the cohort announcement.
list.q13: What is the exact release status of Book 1 (Fractured Code)?
list.a13: The ~74,000-word manuscript (Prologue + 15 chapters + epilogue) completed Gate 2 editorial sign-off on October 29, 2026 and is currently in Gate 3 release preparation. You can read the opening Chapter 1 preview free today; store links will only appear once live.
list.q14: How do digital collectibles and provenance work if nothing is for sale?
list.a14: Our rule is provenance first: disclose every tool today, attach cryptographic content credentials next, and explore signed collector editions later only after legal review and never as an investment or financial product. Read the full guardrail matrix on Collectors & Creators.
list.q15: Which languages are supported across goalworld.fun and play.goalworld.fun?
list.a15: Both surfaces are available in English (EN), Spanish (ES), and Italian (IT). Use the EN | ES | IT switcher in the header or footer — your choice persists across pages, while canonical proper nouns (Neo-Citania, Kora Vega, The Link, Fractured Code) remain consistent worldwide.

privacy.title: Privacy.
privacy.lead: Plain version: this website does not collect personal data. Here are the details.
privacy.s1_li1: It is a static site. There are no accounts, no forms that send data to us, and no user database.
privacy.s1_li2: It sets no tracking cookies and runs no third-party analytics or advertising scripts.
privacy.s1_li3: Fonts and images are served from goalworld.fun itself, not from third-party CDNs.
privacy.s1_li4: Like any web server, the hosting infrastructure may keep standard technical logs (IP address, requested page, timestamp) for security and reliability. These are used for operations only.
privacy.s2_li1: GoalChain Play is a demo that runs in your browser. Game state — profile, balance, predictions, inventory — is stored in your browser's local storage on your own device.
privacy.s2_li2: You may connect a Phantom wallet on Solana Devnet. The demo does not execute real on-chain transactions and does not request transfers of real funds.
privacy.s2_li3: We do not ask for, and you should never send, private keys, seed phrases or passwords to anyone.
privacy.s3_p: This site links to X, GitHub and other external services. Their own privacy policies apply once you leave goalworld.fun.
privacy.s4_p: GoalWorld is a sci-fi saga and a football game demo with no age-gated content or purchases. If you believe a child has sent us personal data, contact us and we will remove it.
privacy.s5_p: If this policy changes, the updated version will be posted on this page. Questions or deletion requests: contact Nico Pez on X at x.com/nicopez.
